title: Kitsuno Handshake — Seeker Application (seeker → vacancy, human-initiated L1)
description: A direct, human-initiated application to a specific vacancy card. This is an L1 fire (handshake.l1_fired) carrying initiated_by='human'. It is NOT a separate state arc: it enters the same conversation state machine at l1_fired, runs the same deterministic policy_match (L1) and validator strong-fit gate (L2) as an agent-initiated fire, and resolves L3 via the same intake_mode x consent grid. The only differences are (1) a human acted, so the conversation owes a report-back signal on a terminal L2 no-match (see signal.json, 'human interaction that creates signal is reported back'), and (2) it MAY carry l3_at_fit to pre-authorize identity disclosure for THIS vacancy at validated fit. Mint-on-apply (a brand-new seeker becoming carded BY applying) is an operator-side on-ramp that produces this event; its mechanics are out of protocol scope.

event_id.description: Idempotency key — receivers MUST deduplicate by this.

conversation_id.description: Stable identifier for this seeker↔vacancy handshake. PER-PAIR COLLISION RULE: if a conversation already exists for this (seeker_card_id, vacancy_card_id) pair from prior discovery, the direct application MUST attach to and advance the existing conversation_id — never open a duplicate, never reset disclosure. Disclosure state is monotonic per pair.

initiated_by.description: Always 'human' for a seeker-application. This is what distinguishes a direct apply from an agent-autonomous L1 fire (see l1-fire.json initiated_by, default 'agent'). The human-acted property is what obligates terminal report-back.

seeker_card_url.description: Where the vacancy agent should GET the seeker card.

l3_at_fit.description: Per-application, situated pre-authorization: 'disclose my L3 identity to THIS vacancy the moment a strong fit is validated.' Raises disclosure for this conversation only; does NOT modify the seeker card's standing consent_policy. A standing-OFF seeker uses this to say yes to one specific vacancy. STILL gated by L1 + L2 first — l3_at_fit is not L3-on-submit; it resolves only after the validator clears. Revocable until L3 actually fires (consistent with the card's revocation commitment), because the human is present and acting on this specific vacancy. A PDF/CV uploaded at apply implies l3_at_fit=true (uploading identity IS the disclosure act), but the field stays explicit so a seeker may pre-authorize without attaching a document (agent discloses from PRS instead).

score.description: Deterministic policy_match score, as in l1-fire.json. A human-initiated application does NOT bypass qualification — it must clear the same gate; a sub-threshold direct apply never advances to a billable L3.

callback_url.description: Where the vacancy agent POSTs the vacancy-signal response AND where the conversation's signals owed to the seeker (l2_no_match feedback, l3_disclosed, l3_initiated) are delivered. Required for human-initiated fires because report-back is owed.

ttl_seconds.description: Seconds before this L1 expires if no vacancy-signal received. Default 14 days.
